# Jeninnet.Validation v1.0.0-preview.1 — The First Preview

Jeninnet.Validation is a modular validation framework for .NET that lets you declare a rule once
and use it everywhere: in generated validators, the fluent API, JSON Schema, OpenAPI, client-side
rules, and your UI. This first preview ships the complete feature set across **25 NuGet packages**,
targets **.NET 11 (STS)** with **C# 15**, and is built for AOT and allocation-sensitive services.

## What this release can do

### 🧱 Declare rules once, execute them through one engine

Put `[Validate]` on a model and rule attributes on its members; the Roslyn source generator emits a
readable partial validator at compile time. Prefer dynamic rules? The fully typed `Validator<T>`
fluent API supports conditions, rule sets, and injected services. Both authoring paths feed the same
execution engine and are pinned by executable parity tests.

### ⚡ Validate without reflection, allocations, or surprises

There is no reflection on the validation path, and the happy path is allocation-free. The same code
runs under NativeAOT, with a smoke harness that publishes and executes in CI. Synchronous validation
is strict: async-only rules fail fast instead of silently blocking.

### 🧩 Cover real validation scenarios

Cascade modes, fail-fast, rule sets, include/exclude strategy, per-rule conditions, dependent rules,
collection count and filter rules, custom sync/async rules with context, lifecycle hooks, and a
shared validation context. Built-in rules are sealed to keep the hot path devirtualizable; extension
points cover the cases that need custom behavior.

### 🌍 Localize messages for real applications

Ships message packs for **40 cultures**, including ICU plural and select support, plus an
`IStringLocalizer`/RESX bridge. Localization is owned by the sibling
[Jeninnet.Localization](https://github.com/TarekNajem04/Jeninnet.Localization) platform, so message
packs and providers are reusable outside validation.

### 🔌 Integrate with the stack you already use

First-class adapters for ASP.NET Core minimal APIs and MVC, the .NET 11
`Microsoft.Extensions.Validation` pipeline, DataAnnotations, Blazor `EditContext`, MediatR
(including ErrorOr, FluentResults, and CSharpFunctionalExtensions result adapters), HotChocolate
GraphQL, gRPC, and desktop `INotifyDataErrorInfo` for WPF, MAUI, and Avalonia.

### 📤 Emit metadata for the whole stack

One frozen descriptor pipeline feeds JSON Schema (draft 2020-12), OpenAPI constraints for
Swashbuckle and NSwag/NJsonSchema, and client-rule export as JSON, TypeScript, or JavaScript. A
dependency-free client evaluator is included, so browser and desktop validation can use the same
rules as the server.

### 🛠 Migrate an existing codebase

The optional `jeninnet` tool reports a readiness score, applies safe codemods for FluentValidation
and DataAnnotations patterns, and marks every uncertain case for review.

## Quick start

```bash
dotnet add package Jeninnet.Validation --version 1.0.0-preview.1
dotnet add package Jeninnet.Validation.Analyzers --version 1.0.0-preview.1
```

```csharp
namespace MyApp.Models;

using Jeninnet.Validation.Attributes;

[Validate]
public partial class User
{
    [NotEmpty]
    public string? Name { get; set; }

    [NotEmpty, Email]
    public string? Email { get; set; }

    [InclusiveBetween(18, 120)]
    public int Age { get; set; }
}
```

```csharp
using Jeninnet.Validation.Abstractions;
using Jeninnet.Validation.Catalog;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using MyApp.Models;

var services = new ServiceCollection();
services.AddValidation();

using var provider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
var validator = provider.GetRequiredService<IValidator<User>>();
var result = validator.Validate(new User { Name = "", Email = "bad", Age = 10 });

foreach (var error in result.Errors)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"{error.MemberName}: {error.Message ?? error.MessageKey}");
}
```

## Release highlights

- **.NET 11 target.** Every shipping library targets `net11.0`; the analyzer targets
  `netstandard2.0`. `Jeninnet.Validation.DataAnnotations` and
  `Jeninnet.Validation.Extensions.Validation` ship `lib/net11.0` assets.
- **C# 15.** The solution builds with the .NET 11 SDK and `LangVersion=15.0`.
- **.NET 11 validation API.** The `Microsoft.Extensions.Validation` adapter implements
  `IValidatableTypeInfo`/`IValidatableParameterInfo`, so minimal-API parameter validation works on
  .NET 11.
- **Capability parity.** Covers **93/93 (100%)** of the .NET 10 peer-capability union, with
  per-peer coverage and honest limits documented.
- **Compile-time safety.** 33 `VAL` diagnostics and code fixes reject invalid rule configurations
  before the code runs.
- **Zero-allocation happy path.** Benchmark evidence and an allocation audit are included, with
  NativeAOT verification in CI.
- **Optional input sanitization.** `Sanitize`/`[Sanitize]` handles trimming and normalization
  without a second model.
- **26 samples.** Including Clean Architecture and XML-localization samples.

## Quality

- **997 tests passing** on `net11.0`; build 0 warnings / 0 errors.
- SonarCloud quality gate: 80.2% coverage, 0.0% duplicated lines, 0 open issues.
- ReportGenerator all-assembly baseline: 79.1% line / 65.2% branch / 84.6% method across 25
  assemblies (2026-11-12).
- Package validation, package-content checks, and a packed-package consumer smoke test pass for all
  25 packages.
- AOT/trimming analyzers clean; the NativeAOT smoke harness publishes and runs in CI.

## Compatibility and known limitations

- The first release targets `net11.0` only. The analyzer targets `netstandard2.0`.
- Generated validators require the model to declare a namespace. Models in the global namespace
  are not supported in this preview; the generator emits them under `<model namespace>.Validators`.
- DataAnnotations and Blazor adapters are synchronous; the .NET 11 async DataAnnotations and
  async Options bridges are planned for `1.1.0-preview.1`.
- The OpenAPI transformer uses JSON property names; custom naming policies may need explicit
  registration.
- Built-in rules are intentionally sealed. Extend through `Custom`/`CustomAsync`, `RuleTemplate`,
  `SyncValidateRule`/`AsyncValidateRule`, or the rule interfaces.
- This is a preview. The API is stabilized against the documented public surface, but review the
  known limitations before adopting it in production.
